_meta.about: Public catalogue (OPAC) pages: shell, home, record, account, browse, courses, sign-in, registration, password reset.

shell.footer_lead: Borrow, reserve and discover — online, any time, in your language.

home.hint_smart: AI search understands plain sentences — try “gentle mysteries set in India”.
home.hint_keyword: Keyword search matches titles, authors, subjects and ISBNs exactly.
home.sub_trending: What readers here are borrowing most
home.empty_body: When the library adds titles they'll appear here.
home.browse_az: Browse every author and subject A–Z
home.visit_sub: Branches, contact details and this week's opening days

rec.be_first: Place a hold and you'll be first in the queue.
rec.no_copies_hint: The library has no lendable copies of this title right now.
rec.signin_hint: You'll be asked to sign in first.
rec.on_hold: On hold · number {n} in the queue
rec.mine_loan: You have this on loan, due {date}.
rec.mine_overdue: You have this on loan and it's overdue.
rec.mine_ready: Ready for you at {branch} — collect by {date}.
rec.similar_hint: Picked by our recommender from what readers of this title also borrowed and from similar subjects.
rec.no_similar_body: As more readers borrow this title, we'll suggest others they enjoyed.
rec.series_hint: See every title in this series in the A–Z index.
rec.be_first_review: Be the first to share what you thought.
rec.hold_copy_hint: Only choose a specific copy if you need that edition or format.
rec.hold_nna_hint: We'll cancel the hold automatically if it isn't ready by then.
rec.missing_body: It may have been removed from the catalogue, or the link is mistyped. Try a search instead.

acct.pause_tip: Going away? Pause a hold to keep your place in the queue without it being filled — it resumes on the date you choose.
acct.pause_intro: You keep your place in the queue for “{title}”, but it won't be filled while paused.
acct.resume_on_hint: Leave empty to keep it paused until you resume it yourself.
acct.cancel_ready_text: It's waiting for you on the hold shelf — cancelling releases it to the next reader.
acct.lists_sub: Save titles to come back to, and share public lists with other readers.
acct.empty_list: This list is empty. Use “Save to list” on any title to add it.
acct.delete_list_text: This deletes the list “{name}”. The books stay in the catalogue.
acct.history_empty_on: Titles you return will be listed here.
acct.history_empty_off: History is off, so returned titles aren't kept.
acct.how_to_pay_body: Pay at any branch desk by cash, card or UPI. Staff can also waive charges in some cases — just ask.
acct.charges_clear_body: Return items on time to keep it that way. We'll remind you before things are due.
acct.set_profile_desc: Your details on the library's records. To change them, ask at any branch desk.
acct.name: Name
acct.set_security_desc: Your password, two-step verification and where you're signed in.
acct.pw_rules_unmet: Choose a password that meets all the rules below.
acct.set_notify_desc: How we tell you about due dates, holds and charges.
acct.add_email: Add an email address at the desk to receive email.
acct.add_phone: Add a mobile number at the desk to receive SMS.
acct.always_sent: Account messages (such as registration and welcome emails) are always sent.
acct.set_privacy_desc: Control what the library keeps about your reading.
acct.set_look_desc: Theme, text size and the language of the catalogue.
acct.suggest_sub: Tell us what the library should buy next.
acct.withdraw_text: Staff won't consider it any more. You can suggest it again later.
acct.suggest_intro: Can't find something in the catalogue? Tell us and we'll consider buying it. We'll let you know what we decide.
acct.sg_title_needed: Enter the title you'd like us to buy.
acct.suggestion_thanks: Thank you! We'll review your suggestion.

pw.rule_classes: Three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols
pw.rule_personal: Doesn't contain your name or email

auth.perk_renew_sub: See due dates and renew before they slip.
auth.perk_holds_sub: Join the queue and we'll tell you when it's ready.
auth.perk_picks_sub: Recommendations computed privately, inside the library.
auth.privacy_foot: Your reading history stays with the library and is never sold or shared.
auth.too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.mfa_lead: Your account is protected with a second step.
auth.mfa_step: Password accepted. One more step to sign in.
auth.mfa_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.recovery_hint: Enter one of your saved recovery codes (for example 1a2b3-c4d5e). Each code works once.
auth.code_wrong: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
auth.mfa_expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.
auth.forgot_lead: Enter your card number or the email address on your account.
auth.forgot_hint: We'll email a link to reset your password. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.enter_identifier: Enter your card number or email address.
auth.link_sent: If an account matches, we've emailed a reset link to its address. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.sso_failed: Single sign-on failed. Please try again.
auth.sso_state: The sign-in attempt expired or was started in another window. Please try again.
auth.sso_denied: Sign-in was cancelled at the identity provider.
auth.sso_provider: That sign-in provider is not available.
auth.sso_provider_unreachable: The identity provider could not be reached. Please try again later.
auth.sso_provider_error: The identity provider returned an unexpected response.
auth.sso_token_exchange: The identity provider rejected the sign-in. Please try again.
auth.sso_signature: The identity provider's response could not be verified.
auth.sso_audience: The identity provider's response was not meant for this library.
auth.sso_issuer: The identity provider's response came from an unexpected issuer.
auth.sso_expired: The identity provider's response has expired. Please try again.
auth.sso_nonce: The sign-in response did not match this attempt. Please try again.
auth.sso_invalid_token: The identity provider's response was invalid.
auth.sso_domain: Your email domain is not allowed to sign in with this provider.
auth.sso_email_unverified: Your identity provider did not confirm your email address.
auth.sso_no_account: No library account matches your email address. Please contact the library.
auth.sso_inactive: This library account is not active.
auth.sso_not_allowed: Your account type cannot sign in with this provider.
auth.sso_locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later or reset your password.
auth.sso_already_linked: That external account is already linked to another library account.

reg.title: Join the library
reg.heading: Join {library}
reg.lead: Register online for a library card. Staff review every application and we'll email you as soon as your account is ready.
reg.aside_lead: Free to join. Borrow books, magazines and films, reserve titles and get personal recommendations.
reg.step3_sub: Sign in with your email and password.
reg.dob_hint: Helps us offer the right collections to young readers.
reg.email_hint: You'll sign in with this address.
reg.phone_hint: For SMS reminders, if you'd like them.
reg.consent: By registering you agree to the library's lending rules. We use your details only to run your account.
reg.closed: Online registration is not available at the moment. Please visit any branch with proof of address to join.
reg.err_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
reg.err_dob: The date of birth can't be in the future.
reg.err_password: Choose a password that meets all the rules.
reg.done_body: Thank you! We'll email {email} as soon as staff have approved your card.
reg.done_next: In the meantime you can browse the catalogue and plan what to borrow.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.lead: For your security, every device signed in to your account will be signed out.
reset.aside_title: A fresh start for your account
reset.aside_lead: Pick a password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.tip_long_sub: A short sentence you'll remember beats a complex word.
reset.tip_unique_sub: A password manager can remember it for you.
reset.done_body: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.missing: This page needs the link from your reset email. It may have expired — request a new one.
reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
reset.failed: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.

browse.title: Browse A–Z
browse.lead: An alphabetical index of authors, subjects and series. Cross-references guide you to the form the catalogue uses.
browse.placeholder_authors: Type the first letters, e.g. “Tag” for Tagore
browse.placeholder_titles: Type the first letters of a series or title
browse.not_used: “{heading}” is not the form used in this catalogue. See
browse.nothing_from: Nothing in this index from “{start}” onwards

courses.title: Course reserves
courses.lead: Readings your instructors have set aside for short loan. Search by course, department or instructor.
courses.none_match_body: Try a shorter course code, or clear the filters.
courses.none_body: When instructors place readings on reserve, their courses appear here.
courses.not_found_body: It may have ended or been withdrawn. Find another course in the list.
courses.no_reserves_body: Your instructor hasn't placed readings for this course yet.
